title.en: Thermal equilibrium, the zeroth law and internal energy
title.kn: ಉಷ್ಣ ಸಮತೋಲನ, ಶೂನ್ಯ ನಿಯಮ ಮತ್ತು ಆಂತರಿಕ ಶಕ್ತಿ

heading.en: How does a thermometer know your temperature?

hook.en: You keep a thermometer under your tongue for a minute. In that minute it comes to the same temperature as your body. That simple idea is a law of physics.
hook.kn: ತಾಪಮಾಪಕವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ ನಾಲಿಗೆಯ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಇಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಆ ನಿಮಿಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ದೇಹದ ತಾಪವನ್ನೇ ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಸರಳ ಕಲ್ಪನೆಯೇ ಒಂದು ಭೌತ ನಿಯಮ.

title.en: Thermal equilibrium and the zeroth law

body.en: Two systems in thermal contact are in thermal equilibrium when their state variables stop changing. Zeroth law: if A and B are each in thermal equilibrium with C, then A and B are in thermal equilibrium with each other. The quantity that is equal for all of them is temperature, so the zeroth law gives us the idea of temperature.
body.kn: ಉಷ್ಣ ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಚರಗಳು ಬದಲಾಗದಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅವು ಉಷ್ಣ ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಶೂನ್ಯ ನಿಯಮ: A ಮತ್ತು B ಎರಡೂ C ಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ A ಮತ್ತು B ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ತಾಪದ ಕಲ್ಪನೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Zeroth law and work done by a gas

say.en: Three systems. A is in thermal equilibrium with C, and B is in thermal equilibrium with C.
Zeroth law: then A and B are in thermal equilibrium with each other. C works as a thermometer, and the shared property is temperature.
Internal energy U is the total kinetic and potential energy of the molecules. It is a state variable. Heat and work are two ways of changing it.

text.en: U depends only on the state

say.en: A gas in a cylinder pushes a piston of area A through a small distance Δx. The force is P A.
A gas at one atmosphere expands by 2 litres: it does 200 joule of work.
On a P–V diagram, the work is the area under the curve. Here pressure is constant, so the area is a rectangle.

narration.en: Three systems. A is in thermal equilibrium with C, and B is in thermal equilibrium with C. Zeroth law: then A and B are in thermal equilibrium with each other. C works as a thermometer, and the shared property is temperature. Internal energy U is the total kinetic and potential energy of the molecules. It is a state variable. Heat and work are two ways of changing it. A gas in a cylinder pushes a piston of area A through a small distance Δx. The force is P A. A gas at one atmosphere expands by 2 litres: it does 200 joule of work. On a P–V diagram, the work is the area under the curve. Here pressure is constant, so the area is a rectangle.

title.en: Three bodies and the zeroth law

narration.en: A and B are separated by an insulating (adiabatic) wall, but each touches C through a conducting (diathermic) wall. Heat flows until A and C, and B and C, are in thermal equilibrium. Then A and B are at the same temperature too: opening the wall between them makes no heat flow. That is the zeroth law, and temperature is what they share.
narration.kn: A ಮತ್ತು B ನಡುವೆ ಉಷ್ಣನಿರೋಧಕ (ಅಡಿಯಾಬ್ಯಾಟಿಕ್) ಗೋಡೆ, ಆದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ವಾಹಕ (ಡಯಾಥರ್ಮಿಕ್) ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ C ಯನ್ನು ಮುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ. A–C ಮತ್ತು B–C ಉಷ್ಣ ಸಮತೋಲನಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುವವರೆಗೆ ಉಷ್ಣ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಗ A ಮತ್ತು B ಕೂಡ ಒಂದೇ ತಾಪದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತವೆ: ಅವುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಗೋಡೆ ತೆರೆದರೂ ಉಷ್ಣ ಹರಿಯದು. ಇದೇ ಶೂನ್ಯ ನಿಯಮ; ಅವು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದೇ ತಾಪ.

body.en: Internal energy U is the sum of the kinetic and potential energies of the molecules of a system, measured in the frame in which the system as a whole is at rest. U is a state variable: it depends only on the state. Heat and work are not state variables; they are two ways of transferring energy. Heat flows because of a temperature difference; work is done by other means, such as a moving piston. Work done by a gas at constant pressure is W = PΔV.
body.kn: ಆಂತರಿಕ ಶಕ್ತಿ U ಎಂದರೆ ಅಣುಗಳ ಚಲನ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ. U ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಚರ. ಉಷ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲಸ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಚರಗಳಲ್ಲ; ಶಕ್ತಿ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆಯ ಎರಡು ವಿಧಗಳು. ಸ್ಥಿರ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ W = PΔV.
